angles.title: The starter is the bakery
angles.thesis: The slow invisible part of the work decides the result, long before anyone sees it.
angles.audience: team leads who reward visible output

uses.quote: If the starter is weak, the loaves come out flat and sour and nobody can fix that at the oven.
That was the moment she knew he would be good.

angles.title: Meetings for decisions only
angles.thesis: A weekly meeting should exist only when there is a decision on the agenda.

uses.quote: So the agenda is upside down.
If there is no decision on the agenda, we cancel the meeting.

open_questions: Will managers accept losing the meeting where they feel informed?

angles.title: Write the toolbox, not the thesis

uses.quote: The essays that actually landed with readers were all small and concrete.
Write the toolbox, not the thesis.

open_questions: Is the bakery story the concrete object this essay needs, or a separate piece?
